about: How a rollout-policy fight is turned into what the MCTS would get (route_sim.correct). Written by `python -m benchmarks.policy_fit fit --write`. Per kind of fight: keep = share of the HP a won fight costs that the MCTS also loses; rescue = chance the MCTS wins a fight the policy lost, by how much enemy HP was left (<= left_edges[0], <= left_edges[1], more); rescue_cost = HP that rescue costs, as a share of the HP the fight began with; won_pairs / lost_runs = the fights the numbers were fitted on (null: not recorded).
